title: A project's agent policy: how long a proposal waits for its person (E150)
description: Three shapes. `read` asks for the policy (any member), `save` sets it (a project administrator, compare-and-set on `expected_generation`), and the root is the policy itself. `wait_hours` is a whole number of hours from 1 to 168; a project that never saved one waits 24 hours, at generation 0. The policy says how long, never who approves or which operations: the person an agent acts for always approves (E5), and the operations a policy may approve stay applications/configure and applications/start (R-A3).
